be374dadf64545617688.en: Animals have different body parts. These parts help them live.
be374dadf64545617688.id: Hewan punya bagian tubuh yang berbeda-beda. Bagian-bagian ini membantu mereka hidup.

fd23ba407f28b31cbca4.en: Birds have feathers, wings and a beak. Most birds can fly.
fd23ba407f28b31cbca4.id: Burung punya bulu (feathers), sayap (wings), dan paruh (beak). Kebanyakan burung bisa terbang.

87b4a8e0af2425d7880f.en: Fish have fins and scales. They swim in water.
87b4a8e0af2425d7880f.id: Ikan punya sirip (fins) dan sisik (scales). Ikan berenang di air.

efcda87a5a4e7d4e0ccc.en: Many animals have fur. Cats, rabbits and monkeys have fur.
efcda87a5a4e7d4e0ccc.id: Banyak hewan punya bulu (fur). Kucing, kelinci, dan monyet punya bulu.

c418e576eeb1aae4b9b7.en: We can sort animals by their legs. Insects have 6 legs and spiders have 8.
c418e576eeb1aae4b9b7.id: Kita bisa mengelompokkan hewan menurut kakinya. Serangga punya 6 kaki dan laba-laba punya 8.

15a8aef996acafeec288.en: A fish has fins. It uses them to swim through the water.
15a8aef996acafeec288.id: Ikan (fish) punya sirip (fins). Ikan memakainya untuk berenang di dalam air.

1e963ecc32beb72e906b.en: A cat has fur and legs.
1e963ecc32beb72e906b.id: Kucing (cat) punya bulu halus (fur) dan kaki.

85364d0904f34a4f46ad.en: A hen has feathers and wings.
85364d0904f34a4f46ad.id: Ayam betina (hen) punya bulu (feathers) dan sayap.

fc175ba73cf9d73c6ceb.en: Insects have 6 legs, 3 on each side. Ladybirds, ants and bees are insects.
fc175ba73cf9d73c6ceb.id: Serangga (insects) punya 6 kaki, 3 di setiap sisi. Kumbang kepik, semut, dan lebah adalah serangga.

10910f306b1d484e776b.en: Birds are the only animals with feathers. Feathers keep them warm and help them fly.
10910f306b1d484e776b.id: Burung (bird) adalah satu-satunya hewan yang punya bulu (feathers). Bulu ini membuat burung tetap hangat dan membantunya terbang.

631be575162674c79fb2.en: A spider has 8 legs, 4 on each side. Insects have 6 legs, so a spider is not an insect.
631be575162674c79fb2.id: Laba-laba (spider) punya 8 kaki, 4 di setiap sisi. Serangga punya 6 kaki, jadi laba-laba bukan serangga.

c59639b1748d77ccf662.en: A fish swims, a bird flies, a snake slithers along the ground and a frog hops.
c59639b1748d77ccf662.id: Ikan berenang (swims), burung terbang (flies), ular merayap di tanah (slithers), dan katak melompat (hops).

1d69fe614cfde131ae5e.en: Cats, rabbits and monkeys have fur. Ducks, owls and hens are birds, so they have feathers.
1d69fe614cfde131ae5e.id: Kucing, kelinci, dan monyet punya bulu halus (fur). Bebek, burung hantu, dan ayam betina termasuk burung, jadi mereka punya bulu burung (feathers).

804b3bc542ced6bbcf6d.en: A fish uses its fins and its tail to push through the water and swim.
804b3bc542ced6bbcf6d.id: Ikan memakai sirip (fins) dan ekor (tail) untuk mendorong tubuhnya di dalam air dan berenang.

19c690be0ca7a3d7f419.en: Birds and bats have wings. Fish do not.
19c690be0ca7a3d7f419.id: Burung dan kelelawar punya sayap (wings). Ikan tidak punya.

3f49bfaa6b90d8fb4b47.en: Cows, lizards and elephants have 4 legs. A hen has 2 legs and an ant has 6.
3f49bfaa6b90d8fb4b47.id: Sapi, kadal, dan gajah punya 4 kaki. Ayam betina punya 2 kaki dan semut punya 6 kaki.

6e732ded63418812d737.en: A hen is a bird with 2 legs.
6e732ded63418812d737.id: Ayam betina (hen) adalah burung yang punya 2 kaki.

13eb8d333f61b8048dab.en: An ant is an insect with 6 legs.

68b4652d4d2ddf3aed00.en: An ant is an insect. Insects have 6 legs and 3 body parts.
68b4652d4d2ddf3aed00.id: Semut (ant) adalah serangga (insect). Serangga punya 6 kaki dan 3 bagian tubuh.

eb023e1b57d1fd9fafaf.en: A spider has 8 legs. Insects have 6.

5678599d9aa795ade569.en: A worm has no legs at all.
5678599d9aa795ade569.id: Cacing (worm) sama sekali tidak punya kaki.

75d5209aac02af07370f.en: A turtle has a hard shell. It protects the turtle's soft body.
75d5209aac02af07370f.id: Kura-kura (turtle) punya cangkang (shell) yang keras. Cangkang itu melindungi tubuh kura-kura yang lunak.

5442cc4ccc50dfb9beb5.en: Snakes and worms have no legs. Hens and penguins are birds with 2 legs. Cats and camels have 4 legs.
5442cc4ccc50dfb9beb5.id: Ular dan cacing tidak punya kaki. Ayam betina dan penguin adalah burung dengan 2 kaki. Kucing dan unta punya 4 kaki.

15e7768e99c4054a5706.en: A penguin is a bird. All birds have feathers, wings and a beak, even birds that cannot fly.
15e7768e99c4054a5706.id: Penguin adalah burung (bird). Semua burung punya bulu (feathers), sayap (wings), dan paruh (beak), termasuk burung yang tidak bisa terbang.

0735d7a8d5df0a55a7ab.en: Penguins swim well, but fish have scales and fins. Penguins have feathers.
0735d7a8d5df0a55a7ab.id: Penguin pandai berenang, tetapi ikan punya sisik dan sirip. Penguin punya bulu (feathers).

b8cf8f11da32848a7ecf.en: Insects have 6 legs. A penguin has 2 legs.
b8cf8f11da32848a7ecf.id: Serangga punya 6 kaki. Penguin punya 2 kaki.

9a282951228dc116765d.en: A duck has webbed feet. The skin between its toes pushes the water like a paddle.
9a282951228dc116765d.id: Bebek punya kaki berselaput (webbed feet). Kulit di antara jari kakinya mendorong air seperti dayung.

2c738b63fdf997feaf4d.en: A duck uses its beak to find food.
2c738b63fdf997feaf4d.id: Bebek memakai paruhnya (beak) untuk mencari makanan.

4218bc30fd1ec44b0a72.en: Feathers keep the duck warm and dry.
4218bc30fd1ec44b0a72.id: Bulu (feathers) membuat bebek tetap hangat dan kering.

d14ac34d51ac7ecbb340.en: A bat is not a bird because it has fur and no feathers. All birds have feathers.
d14ac34d51ac7ecbb340.id: Kelelawar (bat) bukan burung karena punya bulu halus (fur) dan tidak punya bulu burung (feathers). Semua burung punya feathers.

29c3cdfbee4407fcbdc0.en: Some animals that fly are not birds, like bees and bats.
29c3cdfbee4407fcbdc0.id: Beberapa hewan yang bisa terbang bukan burung, seperti lebah dan kelelawar.

1e2725deb2f1df5de73a.en: Insects have wings too. Birds are the animals with feathers.
1e2725deb2f1df5de73a.id: Serangga juga punya sayap. Burung adalah hewan yang punya bulu (feathers).

7c4ca96ea41a88cc225d.en: A cat has 4 legs, a bird has 2 legs and a spider has 8 legs.
7c4ca96ea41a88cc225d.id: Kucing punya 4 kaki, burung punya 2 kaki, dan laba-laba punya 8 kaki.

dea0931ddad67cd285e0.en: Birds are covered in feathers and fish are covered in scales. Cats have fur.
dea0931ddad67cd285e0.id: Tubuh burung tertutup bulu burung (feathers) dan tubuh ikan tertutup sisik (scales). Kucing punya bulu halus (fur).

9b6ec2ee6c48683de651.en: A bird uses its beak to peck and pick up food.
9b6ec2ee6c48683de651.id: Burung memakai paruh (beak) untuk mematuk dan mengambil makanan.

c7441a8f838f9500272f.en: A bird flies by flapping its wings.

4015797bd09c34371350.en: A fish sees with its eyes, just like you.
4015797bd09c34371350.id: Ikan melihat dengan matanya (eyes), sama seperti kamu.

4530f9a5e72c9cebdd8c.en: A fish swims forward by moving its tail from side to side.
4530f9a5e72c9cebdd8c.id: Ikan berenang maju dengan menggerakkan ekornya (tail) ke kiri dan ke kanan.

b4badfd4a573c61eb5cb.en: A hen is a bird. All birds have feathers.
b4badfd4a573c61eb5cb.id: Ayam betina (hen) termasuk burung. Semua burung punya bulu (feathers).

9dd574f3b02a8f525ce5.en: The bird has a beak, a wing, a tail and legs. A fin belongs to a fish.
9dd574f3b02a8f525ce5.id: Burung punya paruh (beak), sayap (wing), ekor (tail), dan kaki (legs). Sirip (fin) adalah milik ikan.

347af53a2f5873d9666d.en: The fish has a tail, a fin and an eye. A wing belongs to a bird.
347af53a2f5873d9666d.id: Ikan punya ekor (tail), sirip (fin), dan mata (eye). Sayap (wing) adalah milik burung.

bf2dab6565037442e274.en: A fish has scales on its body.

eeb76d5faaaf46ce5fbc.en: A rabbit is covered in soft fur.

58614488194ade58c1a9.en: A frog has smooth, wet skin.
58614488194ade58c1a9.id: Katak (frog) punya kulit yang halus dan basah.

8b2bdcf05d1fc4a3fb56.en: A snail carries a shell on its back.

9ab2957b3e42716b65b2.en: A butterfly is an insect. All insects have six legs.
9ab2957b3e42716b65b2.id: Kupu-kupu (butterfly) adalah serangga. Semua serangga punya enam kaki.

01881561731716dd0b19.en: Fish, sharks and whales live in water. Lions, camels and monkeys live on land.
01881561731716dd0b19.id: Ikan, hiu, dan paus hidup di air. Singa, unta, dan monyet hidup di darat.

28c971fa4e79a3dd47e4.en: Birds and bees fly. Fish and whales swim. Cows and lions walk.
28c971fa4e79a3dd47e4.id: Burung dan lebah terbang (fly). Ikan dan paus berenang (swim). Sapi dan singa berjalan (walk).

ae03a7a7dc46825b8bc3.en: Birds, bees and butterflies have wings. Dogs and fish do not.
ae03a7a7dc46825b8bc3.id: Burung, lebah, dan kupu-kupu punya sayap (wings). Anjing dan ikan tidak punya.

2b2a95cb858f3e7a0268.en: Hens, butterflies and most snakes lay eggs. Cows, dogs and rabbits give birth to live babies.
2b2a95cb858f3e7a0268.id: Ayam betina, kupu-kupu, dan sebagian besar ular bertelur. Sapi, anjing, dan kelinci melahirkan anak.

815a74f9485de754e4fb.en: A fish has scales and a hen has feathers. A cat has fur and a snail has a shell.
815a74f9485de754e4fb.id: Ikan punya sisik (scales) dan ayam betina punya bulu burung (feathers). Kucing punya bulu halus (fur) dan siput punya cangkang (shell).

c1a5147ee8f1a3458e70.en: Cats have fur, hens have feathers, fish have scales and snails have a shell.
c1a5147ee8f1a3458e70.id: Kucing punya bulu halus (fur), ayam betina punya bulu burung (feathers), ikan punya sisik (scales), dan siput punya cangkang (shell).

552b0e9e2f234b2605ec.en: A bird has feathers and a beak. A fish has scales and fins.
552b0e9e2f234b2605ec.id: Burung punya bulu (feathers) dan paruh (beak). Ikan punya sisik (scales) dan sirip (fins).

e0574c57eef7632c98cd.en: The duck is covered with feathers. It paddles with its webbed feet.
e0574c57eef7632c98cd.id: Tubuh bebek tertutup bulu (feathers). Bebek mendayung dengan kakinya yang berselaput (webbed feet).

c591eb03b161af4e588a.en: A bee has wings. It can fly.
c591eb03b161af4e588a.id: Lebah (bee) punya sayap (wings). Lebah bisa terbang.

113ccb9309e8d65a567a.en: A snail has a hard shell on its back.
113ccb9309e8d65a567a.id: Siput (snail) punya cangkang (shell) keras di punggungnya.

ecaed269d414cd462ae1.en: The bird stands on its legs.

5b1fa6d3ae5dc6a8949d.en: The tail is at the back of the bird.
5b1fa6d3ae5dc6a8949d.id: Ekor (tail) ada di bagian belakang tubuh burung.

e8e6ecb24cebf620234a.en: Many animals with fur have a tail, such as cats and dogs.
e8e6ecb24cebf620234a.id: Banyak hewan berbulu halus (fur) punya ekor (tail), seperti kucing dan anjing.

5f0222ca6d1a1f0b3682.en: A spider has eight legs and spins a web.
5f0222ca6d1a1f0b3682.id: Laba-laba (spider) punya delapan kaki dan membuat jaring (web).

16a3595e879bc51d3b4a.en: A bird has 2 legs. An insect has 6 legs. 2 + 6 = 8.
16a3595e879bc51d3b4a.id: Burung punya 2 kaki. Serangga punya 6 kaki. 2 + 6 = 8.

260f2ab9670f2ea6b314.en: Bees, ants and butterflies are insects with six legs. A spider has eight legs.
260f2ab9670f2ea6b314.id: Lebah, semut, dan kupu-kupu adalah serangga dengan enam kaki. Laba-laba (spider) punya delapan kaki.

bb7f46c83886cb53a801.en: A hen, a duck and an owl are birds with feathers. A bat has fur.
bb7f46c83886cb53a801.id: Ayam betina, bebek, dan burung hantu adalah burung yang punya bulu (feathers). Kelelawar (bat) punya bulu halus (fur).

40e7c7d2c2d0f4771e9e.en: Birds are the animals with feathers and wings.
40e7c7d2c2d0f4771e9e.id: Burung adalah hewan yang punya bulu (feathers) dan sayap (wings).

baf9db228d89df66ae2b.en: Fish have scales, not fur. Mammals such as cats have fur.
baf9db228d89df66ae2b.id: Ikan punya sisik (scales), bukan bulu halus (fur). Mamalia seperti kucing punya bulu halus.

62c1928b40d44b6cdb5d.en: Cows have hair, and they feed their babies milk. Animals that do this are mammals.
62c1928b40d44b6cdb5d.id: Sapi punya rambut dan menyusui anaknya. Hewan yang seperti ini disebut mamalia (mammal).

c8b99fd0bde14aafa82a.en: A frog is an amphibian. It has no feathers, and most frogs lay their eggs in water.
c8b99fd0bde14aafa82a.id: Katak adalah amfibi. Katak tidak punya bulu (feathers), dan sebagian besar katak bertelur di air.

8d2b292b23a03cbb45b6.en: Butterflies are insects, and all insects have six legs.
8d2b292b23a03cbb45b6.id: Kupu-kupu adalah serangga, dan semua serangga punya enam kaki.
